_doc: Which battle event plays which sound (openspec/changes/sound-effects, design section 3; owner, 2026-11-11: "ok implment it"). fire: a shot's kind to the cue its mount plays as it leaves (pd: a point defence intercept); a kind not listed plays nothing (craft, flares, decoys). hit: what a landed hit plays at the ship struck: shield (the shields took it all), hull, torpedo_hull (a torpedo through to the hull) or destroyed. short: a hit's short alternative, played when another hit landed on the same ship less than short_within_s seconds of battle time before. voices: how many battle sounds play at once (a phone's budget; the quietest new one waits). unit_size_m: the distance at which a sound is at its full level, falling off beyond it; max_distance_m: beyond it a sound is not heard. Every cue is in data/audio/cues.json.
